comparison_policy.provenance: Observation informed the explicit successor law. The executable module contains none of these counts, masses, uncertainties, state names or source locators and cannot open this record. Complete enumeration, unique selection and sealing precede target release.
comparison_policy.multiplets: The sealed independent counts must equal the complete PDG nine equals eight plus one meson organization and twenty-seven equals ten plus eight plus eight plus one baryon organization.
comparison_policy.trajectory: All five inherited natural-parity trajectory rows are squared and interval-propagated with exact fractions. Strict spin/mass ordering and every successive squared-mass interval are retained.
comparison_policy.adverse_boundary: A literal exact common squared-mass step is rejected if the intersection of all four propagated step intervals is empty. This adverse result is part of closure and may not be hidden, fitted away or converted into a free correction.
comparison_policy.formal_scope: The exact Fold theorem is the normalized fixed-carrier affine support law. The resonance comparison tests whether the selected physical mass inscriptions realize that ideal law exactly; it does not select the law or create a fitted tension.
